purpose: Test whether the frozen Level-B v3 sky model darkens too quickly or too slowly from Sun depression 3 deg to 6 deg at matched Koomen 1952 Maryland sky positions, while holding AOD550 and aerosol scenario identical within each model pair.

interpretation.modelPrediction: For each supported pair and each frozen AOD grid point, compute frozen model photopic log luminance at d=3 and d=6 for the same aerosol scenario, then subtract logL6-logL3.
interpretation.union: Diagnostic min/max over all frozen AOD grid points and all five scenarios.
interpretation.outsideUnion: Directional evidence that the modeled 3-to-6-degree darkening shape is inconsistent with this published historical pair over the sampled AOD/scenario set.
